Campus life / GUIDE 03

Less rushing. More arriving.

Check which campus your class is on before planning the journey. NTHU publishes campus shuttle and Nanda–Main Campus shuttle announcements; current notices are more useful than a saved screenshot from an earlier semester.

Reviewed 2026-11-16 · Unofficial student guide

01

Locate tomorrow’s classrooms

Check the building name and campus in your course information. Walk an unfamiliar route before your first class if possible.

02

Open the current shuttle notice

Use the Division of Physical Facilities website and select the timetable whose dates cover your journey. Check stop changes and service notices too.

03

Allow a buffer

Treat a route estimate as a planning aid. Leave extra time for walking to the stop, waiting, and finding the classroom.

04

Have a backup plan

If a shuttle does not fit your schedule, check another transport option before you leave. Confirm the actual service and fare with the provider.

Small things that help

  • Main Campus and Nanda are different destinations; double-check the campus name.
  • Holiday and special-event schedules can differ from regular service.
